parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of your current WAF instance.

parameters.name: MemberAccountIds
parameters.description: The list of WAF member account IDs to manage. You can add up to 10 member accounts at a time.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value.
